==English== ===Etymology=== {{ety|en|id=stop|:inh|enm:cesen>>>|tree=1}} From {{der|en|enm|cesen}}, {{m|enm|cessen}}, from {{der|en|frm|cesser||to cease}}, from {{der|en|la|cessō||leave off}}, frequentative of {{m|la|cēdō||to leave off, go away}}. Compare [[secede]]. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/sis/|a=GA}} * {{IPA|en|/siːs/|a=RP}} * {{audio|en|en-us-cease.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|iːs|s=1}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|formal|intransitive}} To [[stop]]. #: {{syn|en|discontinue|hold|terminate|Thesaurus:end|Thesaurus:stop}} #: {{ux|en|And with that, his twitching '''ceased'''.}} #: {{ux|en|After a short while, it '''cease'''d to rain.}} # {{lb|en|formal|transitive}} To stop doing (something). #: {{syn|en|arrest|discontinue|Thesaurus:desist}} #: {{ux|en|And with that, he '''ceased''' twitching.}} # {{lb|en|obsolete|intransitive}} To be [[want]]ing; to [[fail]]; to [[pass away]], [[perish]]. #: {{syn|en|desert|lack}} #* {{RQ:KJV|Deuteronomy|15|11||The poor shall never '''cease''' out of the land.}} #* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=II|lines=159-161|passage= [...] wherefore '''ceaſe''' we then? / Say they who counſel Warr, we are decreed, / Reſerv'd and deſtin'd to Eternal woe;|year=1873}} #* {{RQ:Tennyson In Memoriam|XXXIV|53|’Twere best at once to sink to peace,
⁠Like birds the charming serpent draws,
⁠To drop head-foremost in the jaws
Of vacant darkness and to '''cease'''.}} ====Conjugation==== {{en-conj|stem=ceas|old=1}} ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|cease and desist|ceaser|ceasefire|ceaseless|never cease to amaze|unceasable|unceasing|unceased|wonders never cease|without cease}} ====Related terms==== * {{col|en|cessation|cede|secede}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|intransitive}} * Albanian: * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Cornish: * Czech: * Danish: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Gothic: * Hungarian: * Italian: * Japanese: * Korean: * Macedonian: * Malayalam: * Māori: * Nahuatl: * Norman: * Occitan: * Ohlone: * Persian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|прекраща́ться|impf}}, {{t+|ru|прекрати́ться|pf}} * Slovak: * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Tocharian B: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|transitive}} * Arabic: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Comorian: * Cornish: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Gothic: * Hebrew: * Hungarian: * Ido: * Ingrian: * Italian: * Japanese: * Korean: * Malayalam: * Māori: * Navajo: * Norman: * Persian: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|прекраща́ть|impf}}, {{t+|ru|прекрати́ть|pf}}, {{t+|ru|перестава́ть|impf}}, {{t+|ru|переста́ть|pf}} * Scottish Gaelic: * Slovak: * Spanish: * Swahili: * Swedish: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|?}} # {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[cessation|Cessation]]; [[extinction]] (see [[without cease]]). #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Hamlet|III|iii|passage=the '''cease''' of majesty}} ====Translations==== {{trans-see|cessation}} ===Anagrams=== * {{anagrams|en|a=acees|escae}} {{cln|en|raising verbs}} {{C|en|Time}}
